scope: Offline research only; no device access or firmware/source edits
primary_event_set: All 5019 events accepted by the existing archived firmware-equivalent flags, identical for every estimator; no new quality or energy cuts. Keep all 5625 candidates in event output.
interpolation: Three-point concave parabola about sampled minimum, maximum half-sample shift; fall back to sampled peak on boundaries or invalid curvature
internal_split: 30 training events per chronological block of 100 accepted events; floor(0.3*n) in final partial block; all others validation
scaling: One constant positive median(method/area8) on training records with nonzero area8; no event correction, offset or peak alignment. All records retained in histograms.
fit_model: Bin-integrated Gaussian plus nonnegative linear continuum; binned Poisson deviance
primary_fits: Fixed internal validation subset; all-event fits and original-2048-bin quantization checks are secondary. No automatic winner or parameter search.
r11_downsample_diagnostic: Retain every 5th original sample for all five possible phases; same full-rate pretrigger baseline in all phases. Compare sampled and 3-point parabolic peaks to original 20 MS/s sampled peak; no ADC requantization, analog filter model or simulated Nano resolution.
limits: Archived Nano run has different gain/settings from later 600-second histogram. Its absolute amplitudes and fitted widths must not be equated with that later run.
Existing accepted-event set and internal split are not blind independent acquisition or detector efficiency.
Inherited fit window is an analysis assumption, not calibrated energy.
Native/offline replay cannot establish ARM timing, ADC behavior or hardware improvement.
